name: Steak with Arugula, Caramelized Onions & Balsamic Mushrooms
instructions: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onions and, stirring frequently, cook until softened and starting to brown, about 10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add mushrooms to pan with onion. Season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until tender, 5-6 minutes.
Add vinegar to onion and mushrooms. Scrape up browned bits from the bottom of the pan and stir until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange a bed of arugula on a plate, add onion and mushrooms, and top with steak slices. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
